title: Grateful Dead Live at Academy of Music on 1972-03-21
lineage: Master Soundboard Reel (2 track)-> Dat-> Dat-> Sonic Solutions-> CD-> EAC-> SHN CD-> EAC-> SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a scorching 1972 partial set – Truckin', a monster 17‑minute The Other One into Wharf Rat and a stellar Big Railroad Blues.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as near‑perfect and crystal clear, with only occasional pop glitches that don’t detract from the listening experience. Musically the band is in top form – “all cylinders clicking,” delivering a high‑energy performance highlighted by Truckin', an epic The Other One/Wharf Rat sequence and one of the best Big Railroad Blues ever heard.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently glowing reviews (5‑star) emphasize both an excellent soundboard recording and a high‑energy, tight performance with multiple standout moments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with minor pop glitches; no major dropouts noted. Partial set but the existing material sounds pristine.

standout_songs: The Other One (17 min) → Wharf Rat
show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial set flows smoothly from a powerhouse Truckin' into an extended The Other One that resolves nicely into Wharf Rat; the overall pacing is tight and energetic.
